opening.argument: A claimed 1000-baht ATM withdrawal is presented as successful, with the speaker saying, “you can see okay successful transition,” while a sampled frame shows a payment card and paper document held in front of an ATM. That financial-access claim is paired with an explicit invitation to join a OneCoin team. The combination presents an apparent transaction as a reason to participate, supporting the position that this is recruitment through commissions and tiered matrices. The records do not establish that the external signup destination operates as described, what fees or eligibility conditions apply, or independently verify that the withdrawal succeeded. Those limits matter: they leave the transaction and the terms uncertain, and do not establish losses or outcomes. But the visible card and receipt, claimed withdrawal, and direct team invitation together make the recruitment appeal clear.
